items.title: Frank Wess — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: The musical director for the thing’s name was Patterson. But I don’t really remember who did what to whom. (Laughs) But I do remember doing it.

ctx.x: You have to remember that person if they paid for it. Don’t forget that name.

No, well I don’t know. The musical director for the thing’s name was Patterson. But I don’t really remember who did what to whom. (Laughs) But I do remember doing it. I think we might have done two of those.
